component.name: AnimatedPoster
component.script:
sub init() m.poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.sprite = m.top.findNode("sprite")
' Determine if this is a sprite sheet isSpriteSheet = (m.top.frameWidth > 0) and (m.top.frameHeight > 0) and (m.top.frameCount > 1)
if isSpriteSheet then setupSpriteSheet() else setupStaticPoster() end if end sub
' ------------------------------- ' STATIC POSTER MODE ' ------------------------------- sub setupStaticPoster() m.sprite.visible = false m.poster.visible = true
m.poster.uri = m.top.uri
' Wait for metadata so we can compute aspect ratio m.poster.observeField("loadStatus", "onPosterLoaded") end sub
sub onPosterLoaded() meta = m.poster.getLoadStatus()
if meta.status = "ready" then w = meta.width h = meta.height
if w > 0 then aspect = h / w m.poster.width = m.top.targetWidth m.poster.height = m.top.targetWidth * aspect end if end if end sub
' ------------------------------- ' SPRITE SHEET MODE ' ------------------------------- sub setupSpriteSheet() m.poster.visible = false m.sprite.visible = true
m.sprite.uri = m.top.uri m.sprite.frameWidth = m.top.frameWidth m.sprite.frameHeight = m.top.frameHeight m.sprite.frameCount = m.top.frameCount
' FPS → msPerFrame if m.top.fps > 0 then m.sprite.msPerFrame = 1000 / m.top.fps else m.sprite.msPerFrame = 100 end if
' Auto-scale height based on frame aspect ratio aspect = m.top.frameHeight / m.top.frameWidth m.sprite.width = m.top.targetWidth m.sprite.height = m.top.targetWidth * aspect
m.sprite.playing = true end sub
